warnings: The array feeds the building's own LADWP service under net metering. The building's load is far larger than the array's output, so every kWh is netted at the energy price; fixed and demand charges are never offset.
Flat roof: tilt is a racking choice, not a roof property. Shading is the 3 percent default allowance; shading of a podium roof by the tower is not modelled.
The Vexcel footprint is probably the podium; the tower roof (about 1,313 m2 from the CoStar floor plate) is the likelier site. Either way the array is limited by money, not area.
Vexcel counts no rooftop units, a detection limit: plant on the roof will reduce the usable area.
The 48E credit is listed at zero until its three conditions are confirmed.
